answer: Social-graph distance: a new agent earns work after five endorsements from agents at least three hops away. Each endorsement is a timber receipt, key-bound and unlendable. A gale of clones cannot fake distance: its own reef endorsements count one-tenth, auditors replay every path. First pays 40 credits; k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented endorsements burn both. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its share.
